home.title: Yodoku — Daily Word Games
home.subtitle: Seven daily games. One minute each. Free forever.

gameDescriptions.lettermix: Find the solution words tucked inside a scrambled string — and clear every single letter.
gameDescriptions.changebyone: Transform a word into another, one letter at a time. Every step must be a real word.
gameDescriptions.wordpool: Name every word in the category. Each level narrows the constraint until only a handful qualify.
gameDescriptions.orderle: Put a handful of items in the correct order — one swap at a time. Then learn why the order matters.
gameDescriptions.fermi: Guess the real-world number. Learn orders of magnitude. Calibrate your intuition — one question a day.
gameDescriptions.quiz: Ten questions a day across eleven categories. One shared score — bragging rights included.
gameDescriptions.seven: Seven letters, one center. Build words, chase the pangram.

lettermix.title: Clear the String
lettermix.description: Clear the String is a free daily word game: rearrange the letters to clear the string. Play today's puzzle and browse past dates on Yodoku.

changebyone.title: Change by One
changebyone.description: Change by One is a free daily word-ladder game: turn one word into another, one letter at a time. Play today's puzzle on Yodoku.

wordpool.title: Word Pool
wordpool.description: Word Pool is a free daily word game: pick the words that fit the category. Play today's puzzle on Yodoku.
wordpool.findWords: Find all words in the category

orderle.title: ORDERLE
orderle.description: ORDERLE is a free daily sequencing game: put the items in the correct order. Play today's puzzle on Yodoku.
orderle.itemsInOrder: All items in the correct order!
orderle.learnMore: Learn why this is the order

fermi.title: FERMI
fermi.description: FERMI is a free daily estimation game: make your best guess and get scored on how close you are. Play today's puzzle on Yodoku.

quiz.title: Quiz Master
quiz.description: Quiz Master is a free daily trivia quiz with questions across eleven categories. Play today's 10-question quiz on Yodoku.
quiz.question: Question

seven.title: 7 Letters
seven.description: 7 Letters is a free daily word game in the style of the classic spelling bee: make words from seven letters. Play today's puzzle on Yodoku.

plus.title: Yodoku+
plus.description: Yodoku+ unlocks the full puzzle archive, an ad-free experience and more. Support Yodoku and play every past daily puzzle.
